body: Fix SHOULD-FIX #3 (consensus-fix multi-pass dryPasses & gate-manifest recording), SHOULD-FIX #4 (do not unconditionally skip AGENTS.md and .adlc/tickets/* in verifyScopeAndAntiNoOp; update discardProjection), SHOULD-FIX #5 (check isDirty and acquireRepoLock before ensureGitignore), SHOULD-FIX #6 (UTF-8 encoding for $ArgsFile in job-object-wrapper.ps1), SHOULD-FIX #7 & #8 (ignore ambient store env overrides and fail closed on symlinked store paths in lib/active-rails.mjs), SHOULD-FIX #9 (fail closed on hollow-test exit code 1), and SHOULD-FIX #10 (reject leading dashes and pass --end-of-options in reviewDiff).
title: Remediate Scheduler, Worktrees, PowerShell Wrapper & ADLC Gate findings from 1.2.0 release audit
